The original box was packaged nicely ensuring the box and product would not be damage during shipping.  Newegg provided an unbeatable price for this shaver and the shipping time was outstanding.  The shaver was delivered well before the indicated shipping arrival date.  Awesome experience with this seller.  I highly recommend doing business with Newegg!

Lightning speed shipment. Great Ebayer communicator. Wonderful the As Rock 750Watt power supply is described to the T! Well packaged;with a quality, value, condition, and appearance most excellent. Again, Wonderful, great condition and packaging was very ‘Vinnie Minnie’. The psu(s) were all clean, quality and  a good value with overwhelming appearance and high quality. For the price is surprising, and  most excellent. Thank You Too Many.

The shipping was timely and the customer service was polite, and response time was slow. Regarding the case, the assembly quality was disappointing and the packaging was inadequate for the price, which allowed internal components to come loose during transit. The photos were misleading and should have double checked model number; I would have returned it for a refund, I had a client deadline I ended up using my own spare iCUE fans to complete the build. It is a high-quality chassis,

Awesome seller. Highly recommended. Very fast shipping and reasonable cost. Item came in as-described condition in the listing and was more than adequately packaged. It looks great, just like the pictures. Excellent communication with the seller. A quality product and great buy for the money. A+ and 5 Stars all around!

As always Excellent experience with newegg.  Fast shipping. Well packaged. Great price. Great quality, brand New. Great seller, you can buy with confidence. I hope to continúe doing business with you again soon. 5 starts for them. Nice and great Communication skills. If you are polite and have evidence or proof of your problem, they will no hesitate to help you.

It was marked out side the box and on all the as the Item I ordered, but upon opening it I noticed that  rtx 2000 and not rtx2000E was not, the E was missing. I contacted the manufacturer(PNY) and they said that was wrong for the ada E the the should be stamped and they confirmed it had the product number for the regular rtx 2000 not the rtx2000E. I don't know what happened, but PNY said they wouldn't guarantee it and to return it so I did and newegg was great. Have bought another item all good.

Shipping was incredibly fast. My package arrived within 3 days of the order being placed. Nothing was damaged and arrived as described in the pictures. I even got a door dash code included. Highly recommend this seller.
